This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* __->__ #43607
* #43606
* #43605

On hold: defer this file split until connection resolution and layer stack assembly have clearer responsibility boundaries.

## Motivation

After separating declarations and connection resolution, the remaining module only collects and binds a layer stack. Give that responsibility an explicit module name and remove the old factories module.

## Changes

Rename the remaining assembly module to stack.py, update production imports and fixture patch lookup to its actual definition site, and refresh the developer guide module map. Package exports remain direct references to the same implementations.

## Validation

All 49 original definitions have a single owner across declarations.py, connections.py and stack.py, with unchanged ASTs. Execution-side definitions are unchanged. Independent imports, API/default identity, a single environment read, exact caller source line, nested/exception stack restoration and actual handoff patch execution pass. Runtime/test imports of factories.py are absent. The TP4 input-scattered resolver probe preserves its counts. All pre-commit checks pass.
